Key_Findings: Cluster RCT (46 villages, Malawi); positive intent-to-treat effects on savings and consumption smoothing; modest effects on business investment/income
Limitations: ITT dilutes true effect due to partial compliance; single-country context limits external validity
Open_Questions: Does effect persist beyond RCT window?

Key_Findings: Synthesis of VSLA/savings-group RCTs across countries; savings & resilience effects consistently positive; income/business effects mixed and smaller
Limitations: Heterogeneity across contexts complicates pooling; publication bias toward positive results
Open_Questions: What governance structure generalizes across contexts?

Key_Findings: Systematic review of microfinance impact studies; average effects on poverty/income are small; strongest evidence for consumption smoothing and female empowerment
Limitations: Many underlying studies non-experimental; selection bias in who takes loans

Key_Findings: Case studies of MFI loan securitization/ABS in Africa (incl. NSIA Cote d'Ivoire, solar securitization Rwanda); shows feasibility but requires scale, standardized data, legal/ratings infrastructure
Limitations: Small sample of deals; mostly larger MFIs, not yet community-group (VSLA) level assets

Key_Findings: G20/OECD review of blended finance de-risking; guarantees and concessional capital mobilize private investment but effectiveness/mobilization ratios vary widely; risk of subsidizing bankable deals
Limitations: Limited rigorous counterfactual evaluation of blended finance outcomes; mostly descriptive/case-based
Open_Questions: What blended structure fits our risk profile?

Key_Findings: Indirect Microcredit-Backed Securitization (IMBS) model: SPV buys receivables from MFI, tranches by risk; senior/junior structure improves rating for senior notes
Limitations: Requires standardized loan data, legal transferability of receivables, and credit enhancement/first-loss layer to be investable
Open_Questions: What minimum pool size/data standardization is needed for VSLA-level receivables to be tranche-able?

Key_Findings: Parametric microinsurance can improve financial resilience and speed of payout vs indemnity insurance, but take-up remains low without subsidy/bundling
Limitations: Basis risk (payout doesn't match actual loss) undermines trust and renewal rates
Open_Questions: Can parametric triggers be designed around VSLA/group-level shocks (e.g.
Link_Citation: migrant remittance disruption) rather than only weather?

Key_Findings: Pools many small distributed-asset loans (solar) from multiple originators into one tradable ABS; template for aggregating small, geographically dispersed receivables
Limitations: Required donor/DFI anchor investment and standardized origination protocol across developers to make pool credible
Open_Questions: Direct analogue for pooling VSLA/community loans across multiple NGOs into one aggregation vehicle - what standardization is required?
